text: 国家统计局：第三季度金融业GDP同比增长4.1%，房地产业GDP同比下降0.4%，住宿和餐饮业GDP同比增长6.3%。
text_en: National Bureau of Statistics: In the third quarter, GDP for the financial sector grew 4.1% year on year, GDP for the real estate sector fell 0.4% year on year, and GDP for the accommodation and catering sector grew 6.3% year on year.
